key: Semi-arid/extensive-veld range (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) used as the primary value; the same sentence's 8 kg/year figure is for a different system (sheep grazing CULTIVATED pastures) and is deliberately excluded from the range rather than averaged in. A Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) Dohne Merino Extensive enterprise budget (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) separately reports total flock wool sold as 4439.64 kg from a flock of '1 519' Smallstock Units, i.e. 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - not used as the primary value because the source does not state that 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 sheep (SSU is a standardised stock-class weighting, not a literal head count), so converting it to kg/sheep would require an unstated conversion factor. A separate NWGA/Mandela Initiative paper on the Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program reports a Grootfontein ADI progeny-test 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [commercial rams] 2.4 [communal rams]' for communal Eastern Cape flocks - not merged into the primary value because that table is explicitly for '6-month old lambs' (a different life stage from a mature sheep's full annual clip), consistent with the rule against mixing figures across life stages; kept here only as EC-communal context: commercial-ram-sired lambs at 6 months averaged 2.8 kg, communal-ram-sired lambs 2.4 kg, a +16% difference.
english: Semi-arid/extensive-veld range (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) used as the primary value; the same sentence's 8 kg/year figure is for a different system (sheep grazing CULTIVATED pastures) and is deliberately excluded from the range rather than averaged in. A Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) Dohne Merino Extensive enterprise budget (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) separately reports total flock wool sold as 4439.64 kg from a flock of '1 519' Smallstock Units, i.e. 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - not used as the primary value because the source does not state that 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 sheep (SSU is a standardised stock-class weighting, not a literal head count), so converting it to kg/sheep would require an unstated conversion factor. A separate NWGA/Mandela Initiative paper on the Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program reports a Grootfontein ADI progeny-test 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [commercial rams] 2.4 [communal rams]' for communal Eastern Cape flocks - not merged into the primary value because that table is explicitly for '6-month old lambs' (a different life stage from a mature sheep's full annual clip), consistent with the rule against mixing figures across life stages; kept here only as EC-communal context: commercial-ram-sired lambs at 6 months averaged 2.8 kg, communal-ram-sired lambs 2.4 kg, a +16% difference.
draft: Semi-ariede/ekstensiewe-veld-reeks (4-5 kg vetwol/skaap/jaar) as die primêre waarde gebruik; dieselfde sin se syfer van 8 kg/jaar is vir 'n ander stelsel (skape wat op AANGEPLANTE weidings wei) en word doelbewus uit die reeks uitgesluit eerder as om in 'n gemiddelde ingereken te word. 'n Begroting van die Wes-Kaapse Regering (Elsenburg) vir 'n ekstensiewe Dohne Merino-onderneming (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) rapporteer afsonderlik die totale kuddewol verkoop as 4439.64 kg uit 'n kudde van '1 519' Kleinvee-eenhede, d.w.s. 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Kleinvee-eenheid/jaar - nie as die primêre waarde gebruik nie omdat die bron nie sê dat 1 Kleinvee-eenheid = 1 skaap nie (SSU is 'n gestandaardiseerde veeklas-weging, nie 'n letterlike koptelling nie), so om dit na kg/skaap om te skakel, sou 'n ongestelde omskakelingsfaktor vereis. 'n Aparte NWGA/Mandela Initiative-artikel oor die Oos-Kaapse gemeenskaplike Wolskaap-ontwikkelingsprogram rapporteer 'n Grootfontein ADI-nageslagtoets 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [commercial rams] 2.4 [communal rams]' vir gemeenskaplike Oos-Kaapse kuddes - nie by die primêre waarde saamgevoeg nie omdat daardie tabel uitdruklik vir '6-month old lambs' is ('n ander lewensfase as 'n volwasse skaap se volle jaarlikse skeersel), in ooreenstemming met die reël teen die meng van syfers oor lewensfases; slegs hier gehou as Oos-Kaapse gemeenskaplike konteks: lammers van kommersiële ramme op 6 maande het gemiddeld 2.8 kg gehad, lammers van gemeenskaplike ramme 2.4 kg, 'n verskil van +16%.

draft: Water wat in die droë maande opraak — die grootste enkele dryfveer hier; een gemiste maand kan die hele gewassiklus kos, en dit is die gaping tussen die twee besproeide bande hierbo en die twee wat nie besproei word nie.

english: Field-position ranges come from mapped area and published spacing; they are not guaranteed buy quantities or germination/loss allowances. Verskaffer- en gewasspesifieke riglyne kan verander wat om te koop. Botaniese saadhoeveelheid word nie uit volwasse spasiëring afgelei nie: gebruik die pakkie se gewasspesifieke tempo vir direkte saai en riglyne vir ontkieming. Bestekke van plantstukke word slegs gewys vir saailinge, huisies, stingelknolle, steggies en saadaartappels wanneer albei spasiëringsasse geverifieer is. Waar 'n ry-uitleg nie geverifieer is nie, bevestig dit plaaslik voordat jy materiaal koop.

key: If the sale already has an invoice, choose its View or View invoice link. A buyer asking for another copy does not mean another sale.
english: If the sale already has an invoice, choose its View or View invoice link. A buyer asking for another copy does not mean another sale.
draft: As die verkoping reeds 'n faktuur het, kies sy Bekyk- of Bekyk faktuur-skakel. 'n Koper wat vir nog 'n afskrif vra, beteken nie nog 'n verkoping nie.

key: For a sale that is not recorded, choose New sale & invoice. For an older sale or paper document, choose Past sale / paper invoice and keep the original reference and date.
english: For a sale that is not recorded, choose New sale & invoice. For an older sale or paper document, choose Past sale / paper invoice and keep the original reference and date.
draft: Vir 'n verkoping wat nie aangeteken is nie, kies Nuwe verkoping en faktuur. Vir 'n ouer verkoping of papierdokument, kies Vorige verkoping / papierfaktuur en hou die oorspronklike verwysing en datum.

key: You know whether you are opening an existing record or adding a genuinely unrecorded sale.
english: You know whether you are opening an existing record or adding a genuinely unrecorded sale.
draft: Jy weet of jy 'n bestaande rekord oopmaak of 'n verkoping byvoeg wat werklik nie aangeteken is nie.

key: What are you recording? → Is this sale already in My Records?
english: What are you recording? → Is this sale already in My Records?
draft: Wat teken jy aan? → Is hierdie verkoping reeds in My rekords?

key: Read the selected Invoice type. For Produce already sold or An invoice already written on paper, answer whether the sale is already recorded. Choose the exact existing sale when linking one.
english: Read the selected Invoice type. For Produce already sold or An invoice already written on paper, answer whether the sale is already recorded. Choose the exact existing sale when linking one.
draft: Lees die gekose Faktuurtipe. Vir Produkte reeds verkoop of 'n Faktuur wat reeds op papier geskryf is, antwoord of die verkoping reeds aangeteken is. Kies die presiese bestaande verkoping wanneer jy een koppel.

key: Make these choices first. Changing the invoice type or existing-sale choice starts a fresh form, so check the details again before saving.
english: Make these choices first. Changing the invoice type or existing-sale choice starts a fresh form, so check the details again before saving.
draft: Maak eers hierdie keuses. As jy die faktuurtipe of die keuse van 'n bestaande verkoping verander, begin 'n nuwe vorm, so kontroleer die besonderhede weer voordat jy stoor.

key: For a paper copy, enter the original paper reference. The invoice issue date is not automatically the day the buyer paid.
english: For a paper copy, enter the original paper reference. The invoice issue date is not automatically the day the buyer paid.
draft: Vir 'n papierafskrif, voer die oorspronklike papierverwysing in. Die uitreikdatum van die faktuur is nie outomaties die dag waarop die koper betaal het nie.

key: The source choice and any linked sale match your evidence.
english: The source choice and any linked sale match your evidence.
draft: Die bronkeuse en enige gekoppelde verkoping stem ooreen met jou bewyse.

key: Bill to → Crop or product → Quantity → Unit → Price each
english: Bill to → Crop or product → Quantity → Unit → Price each
draft: Faktureer aan → Gewas of produk → Hoeveelheid → Eenheid → Prys elk

key: Use the agreed price. A suggested crop price is a guide, not the buyer’s agreement. Compare the line amounts and total with your source.
english: Use the agreed price. A suggested crop price is a guide, not the buyer’s agreement. Compare the line amounts and total with your source.
draft: Gebruik die ooreengekome prys. 'n Voorgestelde gewasprys is 'n riglyn, nie die koper se ooreenkoms nie. Vergelyk die reëlbedrae en totaal met jou bron.

key: Choose a growing area only when the invoice belongs to it. Keep a mixed invoice unassigned rather than giving one bed income from another activity.
english: Choose a growing area only when the invoice belongs to it. Keep a mixed invoice unassigned rather than giving one bed income from another activity.
draft: Kies 'n groeiarea slegs wanneer die faktuur daaraan behoort. Laat 'n gemengde faktuur ontoegewys eerder as om een bedding inkomste uit 'n ander aktiwiteit te gee.

key: The buyer, units, quantity, agreed price and total agree with the source record.
english: The buyer, units, quantity, agreed price and total agree with the source record.
draft: Die koper, eenhede, hoeveelheid, ooreengekome prys en totaal stem ooreen met die bronrekord.

key: Record whether the full payment arrived
english: Record whether the full payment arrived
draft: Teken aan of die volle betaling opgedaag het

key: Has the buyer paid? → Payment received on → Payment method
english: Has the buyer paid? → Payment received on → Payment method
draft: Het die koper betaal? → Betaling ontvang op → Betaalmetode

key: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding if the money is still due. Choose Yes — paid in full only after checking that the full payment arrived.
english: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding if the money is still due. Choose Yes — paid in full only after checking that the full payment arrived.
draft: Kies Nog nie — betaling uitstaande as die geld nog verskuldig is. Kies Ja — ten volle betaal slegs nadat jy nagegaan het dat die volle betaling opgedaag het.

key: For full payment, check the actual receipt date and method. A payment promise or screenshot from the buyer needs checking against your own receipt evidence.
english: For full payment, check the actual receipt date and method. A payment promise or screenshot from the buyer needs checking against your own receipt evidence.
draft: Vir volle betaling, kontroleer die werklike ontvangsdatum en metode. 'n Betaalbelofte of skermskoot van die koper moet teen jou eie ontvangsbewyse nagegaan word.

key: Keep every instalment’s actual receipt date in that separate record. The app gives a paid invoice one payment date for its whole amount, so its charts cannot show the separate instalment dates.
english: Keep every instalment’s actual receipt date in that separate record. The app gives a paid invoice one payment date for its whole amount, so its charts cannot show the separate instalment dates.
draft: Hou elke paaiement se werklike ontvangsdatum in daardie afsonderlike rekord. Die app gee 'n betaalde faktuur een betaaldatum vir sy hele bedrag, so sy grafieke kan nie die afsonderlike paaiementdatums wys nie.

key: The status describes the evidence, and a part payment has not been represented as full payment.
english: The status describes the evidence, and a part payment has not been represented as full payment.
draft: Die status beskryf die bewyse, en 'n gedeeltelike betaling is nie as volle betaling voorgestel nie.

key: Save and check the same invoice
english: Save and check the same invoice
draft: Stoor en kontroleer dieselfde faktuur

key: Save invoice → Saved → Open the same number
english: Save invoice → Saved → Open the same number
draft: Stoor faktuur → Gestoor → Maak dieselfde nommer oop

key: Choose Save invoice and read the message. Open Saved and find the same invoice number, buyer, amount and payment status.
english: Choose Save invoice and read the message. Open Saved and find the same invoice number, buyer, amount and payment status.
draft: Kies Stoor faktuur en lees die boodskap. Maak Gestoor oop en vind dieselfde faktuurnommer, koper, bedrag en betaalstatus.

key: Paid invoices contribute income to My Records; paid kilogram lines can create linked crop-sale records. Other units retain their quantities. An unpaid invoice is not cash received.
english: Paid invoices contribute income to My Records; paid kilogram lines can create linked crop-sale records. Other units retain their quantities. An unpaid invoice is not cash received.
draft: Betaalde fakture dra inkomste by tot My rekords; betaalde kilogramreëls kan gekoppelde gewasverkooprekords skep. Ander eenhede behou hul hoeveelhede. 'n Onbetaalde faktuur is nie kontant ontvang nie.

key: Follow the record back to Sold
english: Follow the record back to Sold
draft: Volg die rekord terug na Verkoop

key: My Records → Sold → View invoice
english: My Records → Sold → View invoice
draft: My rekords → Verkoop → Bekyk faktuur

key: When an unpaid invoice is later paid in full, open that existing invoice or its Review payment button, check the receipt date and save the update. Keep the same invoice number.
english: When an unpaid invoice is later paid in full, open that existing invoice or its Review payment button, check the receipt date and save the update. Keep the same invoice number.
draft: Wanneer 'n onbetaalde faktuur later ten volle betaal word, maak daardie bestaande faktuur of sy Hersien betaling-knoppie oop, kontroleer die ontvangsdatum en stoor die bywerking. Hou dieselfde faktuurnommer.

key: To send another copy, reopen the saved invoice and check Share PDF or Print. Downloading a copy does not send it to a customer. Review the destination yourself before sending.
english: To send another copy, reopen the saved invoice and check Share PDF or Print. Downloading a copy does not send it to a customer. Review the destination yourself before sending.
draft: Om nog 'n afskrif te stuur, maak die gestoorde faktuur weer oop en kontroleer Deel PDF of Druk. Om 'n afskrif af te laai, stuur dit nie na 'n kliënt nie. Hersien self die bestemming voordat jy stuur.

key: You can trace the sale, payment and document without creating a duplicate.
english: You can trace the sale, payment and document without creating a duplicate.
draft: Jy kan die verkoping, betaling en dokument naspeur sonder om 'n duplikaat te skep.

key: Only part of the payment has arrived.
english: Only part of the payment has arrived.
draft: Slegs 'n deel van die betaling het opgedaag.

key: The invoice is for R120.00. The buyer pays R40.00. What should you do?
english: The invoice is for R120.00. The buyer pays R40.00. What should you do?
draft: Die faktuur is vir R120.00. Die koper betaal R40.00. Wat moet jy doen?

key: Mark the invoice paid in full
english: Mark the invoice paid in full
draft: Merk die faktuur as ten volle betaal

key: R80.00 is still owed. Paid in full would misstate the payment; this screen does not track a partial balance.
english: R80.00 is still owed. Paid in full would misstate the payment; this screen does not track a partial balance.
draft: R80.00 is nog verskuldig. Ten volle betaal sou die betaling verkeerd voorstel; hierdie skerm hou nie 'n gedeeltelike saldo by nie.

key: Keep a separate payment record and leave full payment unconfirmed
english: Keep a separate payment record and leave full payment unconfirmed
draft: Hou 'n afsonderlike betaalrekord en laat volle betaling onbevestig

key: Create another R40.00 produce sale
english: Create another R40.00 produce sale
draft: Skep nog 'n produkverkoping van R40.00

key: The payment settles part of the existing sale. It does not describe another delivery of produce.
english: The payment settles part of the existing sale. It does not describe another delivery of produce.
draft: Die betaling vereffen 'n deel van die bestaande verkoping. Dit beskryf nie nog 'n aflewering van produkte nie.

key: The invoice document is saved on this device. A synchronised crop-sale row is not a backup of every document detail. Retain the source and a checked copy.
english: The invoice document is saved on this device. A synchronised crop-sale row is not a backup of every document detail. Retain the source and a checked copy.
draft: Die faktuurdokument is op hierdie toestel gestoor. 'n Gesinkroniseerde gewasverkoopry is nie 'n rugsteun van elke dokumentbesonderheid nie. Hou die bron en 'n nagegaande kopie.

key: A saved invoice or payment status does not by itself prove receipt, full profit or tax compliance. For deposits, adjustments or disputed amounts, keep a checked supporting balance record and get bookkeeping help.
english: A saved invoice or payment status does not by itself prove receipt, full profit or tax compliance. For deposits, adjustments or disputed amounts, keep a checked supporting balance record and get bookkeeping help.
draft: 'n Gestoorde faktuur of betaalstatus bewys nie op sy eie ontvangs, volle wins of belastingnakoming nie. Hou vir deposito's, aanpassings of betwiste bedrae 'n nagegaande ondersteunende saldorekord en kry boekhouhulp.

key: Find your sale before adding another
english: Find your sale before adding another
draft: Vind jou verkoping voordat jy nog een byvoeg

key: Open Sold in your current workspace. Reopen an existing record when there is one.
english: Open Sold in your current workspace. Reopen an existing record when there is one.
draft: Maak Verkoop in jou huidige werkruimte oop. Maak 'n bestaande rekord weer oop wanneer daar een is.

key: Open Sold
english: Open Sold
draft: Maak Verkoop oop

key: Keep the cost and its evidence together.
english: Keep the cost and its evidence together.
draft: Hou die koste en sy bewyse saam.

key: Record what you paid, check the cents and reopen the cost with its supporting receipt.
english: Record what you paid, check the cents and reopen the cost with its supporting receipt.
draft: Teken aan wat jy betaal het, kontroleer die sente en maak die koste weer oop met sy ondersteunende kwitansie.

key: Illustration of a grower considering costs with a notebook, calculator and produce at a homestead table
english: Illustration of a grower considering costs with a notebook, calculator and produce at a homestead table
draft: Illustrasie van 'n kweker wat koste oorweeg met 'n notaboek, sakrekenaar en produkte by 'n opstaltafel

key: Check the source before saving a cost · illustrated example
english: Check the source before saving a cost · illustrated example
draft: Kontroleer die bron voordat jy 'n koste stoor · geïllustreerde voorbeeld

key: Bring the receipt or payment record
english: Bring the receipt or payment record
draft: Bring die kwitansie of betaalrekord

key: Have the item, amount paid and supplier ready. Keep the original payment date. This form records today’s entry date and has no date picker yet.
english: Have the item, amount paid and supplier ready. Keep the original payment date. This form records today’s entry date and has no date picker yet.
draft: Hou die item, bedrag betaal en verskaffer gereed. Hou die oorspronklike betaaldatum. Hierdie vorm teken vandag se inskrywingsdatum aan en het nog geen datumkieser nie.

key: For practice, open the sample tour, choose Record the work and the sale, then Try it now. Choose Spent. Use sample details in a group lesson.
english: For practice, open the sample tour, choose Record the work and the sale, then Try it now. Choose Spent. Use sample details in a group lesson.
draft: Om te oefen, maak die voorbeeldtoer oop, kies Teken die werk en die verkoping aan, dan Probeer dit nou. Kies Bestee. Gebruik voorbeeldbesonderhede in 'n groepsles.

key: Check the book before adding a cost
english: Check the book before adding a cost
draft: Kontroleer die boek voordat jy 'n koste byvoeg

key: My Records → Spent → Log a cost
english: My Records → Spent → Log a cost
draft: My rekords → Bestee → Teken 'n koste aan

key: For a new cost, choose Log a cost. The form is headed Money you paid out.
english: For a new cost, choose Log a cost. The form is headed Money you paid out.
draft: Vir 'n nuwe koste, kies Teken 'n koste aan. Die vorm se opskrif is Geld wat jy uitbetaal het.

key: You know whether to add a new payment or edit an existing cost.
english: You know whether to add a new payment or edit an existing cost.
draft: Jy weet of jy 'n nuwe betaling moet byvoeg of 'n bestaande koste moet wysig.

key: Copy the amount and describe the cost
english: Copy the amount and describe the cost
draft: Kopieer die bedrag en beskryf die koste

key: Write what the payment was for and enter the full amount, including cents. Compare it with the receipt or checked payment evidence.
english: Write what the payment was for and enter the full amount, including cents. Compare it with the receipt or checked payment evidence.
draft: Skryf waarvoor die betaling was en voer die volle bedrag in, insluitend sente. Vergelyk dit met die kwitansie of nagegaande betaalbewyse.

key: Keep the original date in your source record when entering an older cost. The app places this entry in the month you type it.
english: Keep the original date in your source record when entering an older cost. The app places this entry in the month you type it.
draft: Hou die oorspronklike datum in jou bronrekord wanneer jy 'n ouer koste invoer. Die app plaas hierdie inskrywing in die maand waarin jy dit tik.

key: Assign the cost only when you know
english: Assign the cost only when you know
draft: Ken die koste slegs toe wanneer jy weet

key: Growing area for this entry → Crop this cost was for
english: Growing area for this entry → Crop this cost was for
draft: Groeiarea vir hierdie inskrywing → Gewas waarvoor hierdie koste was

key: Choose the growing area only when the cost belongs to it. Shared by beds and staple plots is available for a genuinely shared cost; Unassigned leaves it unallocated.
english: Choose the growing area only when the cost belongs to it. Shared by beds and staple plots is available for a genuinely shared cost; Unassigned leaves it unallocated.
draft: Kies die groeiarea slegs wanneer die koste daaraan behoort. Gedeel deur beddings en stapelvoedselpersele is beskikbaar vir 'n werklik gedeelde koste; Ontoegewys laat dit ongeallokeer.

key: Any growing-area or crop assignment is supported by what the payment actually covered.
english: Any growing-area or crop assignment is supported by what the payment actually covered.
draft: Enige toewysing aan 'n groeiarea of gewas word ondersteun deur wat die betaling werklik gedek het.

key: A receipt photo is optional. You can attach it and fill in the cost yourself. Check that the important details are readable.
english: A receipt photo is optional. You can attach it and fill in the cost yourself. Check that the important details are readable.
draft: 'n Kwitansiefoto is opsioneel. Jy kan dit aanheg en self die koste invul. Kontroleer dat die belangrike besonderhede leesbaar is.

key: The original receipt photo stays on this device. A cost appearing elsewhere does not mean its original photo is available there too.
english: The original receipt photo stays on this device. A cost appearing elsewhere does not mean its original photo is available there too.
draft: Die oorspronklike kwitansiefoto bly op hierdie toestel. 'n Koste wat elders verskyn, beteken nie dat sy oorspronklike foto ook daar beskikbaar is nie.

key: Log cost → Spent → Edit or View slip
english: Log cost → Spent → Edit or View slip
draft: Teken koste aan → Bestee → Wysig of Bekyk strokie

key: Choose Log cost and read the save result. Find that same cost in Spent and compare its amount with your evidence.
english: Choose Log cost and read the save result. Find that same cost in Spent and compare its amount with your evidence.
draft: Kies Teken koste aan en lees die stoorresultaat. Vind daardie selfde koste in Bestee en vergelyk sy bedrag met jou bewyse.

key: You can find the cost again, verify its cents and identify where the original evidence is kept.
english: You can find the cost again, verify its cents and identify where the original evidence is kept.
draft: Jy kan die koste weer vind, sy sente verifieer en identifiseer waar die oorspronklike bewyse gehou word.

key: Save both amounts as separate costs
english: Save both amounts as separate costs
draft: Stoor albei bedrae as afsonderlike koste

key: That would risk counting the same payment twice. Resolve the difference on the one cost.
english: That would risk counting the same payment twice. Resolve the difference on the one cost.
draft: Dit sou die risiko loop om dieselfde betaling twee keer te tel. Los die verskil op die een koste op.

key: Spent records payments, but the app cannot know which costs you have not entered. Sales minus recorded costs does not establish full profit when information is missing.
english: Spent records payments, but the app cannot know which costs you have not entered. Sales minus recorded costs does not establish full profit when information is missing.
draft: Bestee teken betalings aan, maar die app kan nie weet watter koste jy nie ingevoer het nie. Verkope minus aangetekende koste bewys nie volle wins wanneer inligting ontbreek nie.

key: Keep original dates and evidence. Equipment, borrowing and household money need distinct treatment when preparing full accounts; use the finance workbook and your bookkeeper rather than treating every cash movement as a crop cost.
english: Keep original dates and evidence. Equipment, borrowing and household money need distinct treatment when preparing full accounts; use the finance workbook and your bookkeeper rather than treating every cash movement as a crop cost.
draft: Hou oorspronklike datums en bewyse. Toerusting, lenings en huishoudelike geld het elk 'n eie hantering nodig wanneer volledige rekeninge voorberei word; gebruik die finansiewerkboek en jou boekhouer eerder as om elke kontantbeweging as 'n gewaskoste te behandel.

key: Now record a checked cost
english: Now record a checked cost
draft: Teken nou 'n nagegaande koste aan

key: Open Spent in your current workspace. Find an existing entry first, or add the payment once from its source record.
english: Open Spent in your current workspace. Find an existing entry first, or add the payment once from its source record.
draft: Maak Bestee in jou huidige werkruimte oop. Vind eers 'n bestaande inskrywing, of voeg die betaling een keer by uit sy bronrekord.

key: Make an invoice. Keep the sale together.
english: Make an invoice. Keep the sale together.
draft: Maak 'n faktuur. Hou die verkoping saam.

key: Create an invoice, check payment and find the saved document again.
english: Create an invoice, check payment and find the saved document again.
draft: Skep 'n faktuur, kontroleer betaling en vind die gestoorde dokument weer.

key: Bring the buyer, product, quantity, unit, agreed price and dates. Check payment evidence before choosing paid. For practice, open the sample tour and choose Record the work and the sale.
english: Bring the buyer, product, quantity, unit, agreed price and dates. Check payment evidence before choosing paid. For practice, open the sample tour and choose Record the work and the sale.
draft: Bring die koper, produk, hoeveelheid, eenheid, ooreengekome prys en datums. Kontroleer betaalbewyse voordat jy betaal kies. Om te oefen, maak die voorbeeldtoer oop en kies Teken die werk en die verkoping aan.

key: My Records → Invoice → Saved or New invoice
english: My Records → Invoice → Saved or New invoice
draft: My rekords → Faktuur → Gestoor of Nuwe faktuur

key: If the invoice already exists, open Saved and choose that document. A buyer asking for another copy does not mean another sale.
english: If the invoice already exists, open Saved and choose that document. A buyer asking for another copy does not mean another sale.
draft: As die faktuur reeds bestaan, maak Gestoor oop en kies daardie dokument. 'n Koper wat vir nog 'n afskrif vra, beteken nie nog 'n verkoping nie.

key: For a new document, read “What are you recording?” Choose A new invoice, Produce already sold, or An invoice already written on paper.
english: For a new document, read “What are you recording?” Choose A new invoice, Produce already sold, or An invoice already written on paper.
draft: Vir 'n nuwe dokument, lees “Wat teken jy aan?” Kies 'n Nuwe faktuur, Produkte reeds verkoop of 'n Faktuur wat reeds op papier geskryf is.

key: For a past sale or paper copy, answer whether the sale is already in My Records. If it is, link the exact available recorded sale. Keep the original paper reference and issue date.
english: For a past sale or paper copy, answer whether the sale is already in My Records. If it is, link the exact available recorded sale. Keep the original paper reference and issue date.
draft: Vir 'n vorige verkoping of papierafskrif, antwoord of die verkoping reeds in My rekords is. As dit is, koppel die presiese beskikbare aangetekende verkoping. Hou die oorspronklike papierverwysing en uitreikdatum.

key: You can explain whether this is a new sale, an existing sale or another copy of a document.
english: You can explain whether this is a new sale, an existing sale or another copy of a document.
draft: Jy kan verduidelik of dit 'n nuwe verkoping, 'n bestaande verkoping of nog 'n afskrif van 'n dokument is.

key: Check the buyer, units and price
english: Check the buyer, units and price
draft: Kontroleer die koper, eenhede en prys

key: Bill to → Line items → Payment due
english: Bill to → Line items → Payment due
draft: Faktureer aan → Reëlitems → Betaling verskuldig

key: Check your seller details and choose the correct buyer. For each line, check the product, Quantity, Unit and Price each. Use Add line item for another product.
english: Check your seller details and choose the correct buyer. For each line, check the product, Quantity, Unit and Price each. Use Add line item for another product.
draft: Kontroleer jou verkopersbesonderhede en kies die regte koper. Kontroleer vir elke reël die produk, Hoeveelheid, Eenheid en Prys elk. Gebruik Voeg reëlitem by vir nog 'n produk.

key: Check the issue date, payment terms and any buyer reference. Compare the preview with your source record before saving.
english: Check the issue date, payment terms and any buyer reference. Compare the preview with your source record before saving.
draft: Kontroleer die uitreikdatum, betaalvoorwaardes en enige verwysing van die koper. Vergelyk die voorskou met jou bronrekord voordat jy stoor.

key: The buyer, product, quantity, unit, agreed price and total match the source record.
english: The buyer, product, quantity, unit, agreed price and total match the source record.
draft: Die koper, produk, hoeveelheid, eenheid, ooreengekome prys en totaal stem ooreen met die bronrekord.

key: Say whether payment arrived
english: Say whether payment arrived
draft: Sê of betaling opgedaag het

key: Has the buyer paid? → Payment received on
english: Has the buyer paid? → Payment received on
draft: Het die koper betaal? → Betaling ontvang op

key: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding when payment is still due. Choose Yes — paid in full only after the full payment has been received and checked.
english: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding when payment is still due. Choose Yes — paid in full only after the full payment has been received and checked.
draft: Kies Nog nie — betaling uitstaande wanneer betaling nog verskuldig is. Kies Ja — ten volle betaal slegs nadat die volle betaling ontvang en nagegaan is.

key: For a paid invoice, check Payment received on and the payment method. The payment date can be different from the invoice issue date.
english: For a paid invoice, check Payment received on and the payment method. The payment date can be different from the invoice issue date.
draft: Vir 'n betaalde faktuur, kontroleer Betaling ontvang op en die betaalmetode. Die betaaldatum kan van die faktuur se uitreikdatum verskil.

key: The payment status and receipt date describe what actually happened.
english: The payment status and receipt date describe what actually happened.
draft: Die betaalstatus en ontvangsdatum beskryf wat werklik gebeur het.

key: Save invoice → Saved → Open the same invoice
english: Save invoice → Saved → Open the same invoice
draft: Stoor faktuur → Gestoor → Maak dieselfde faktuur oop

key: Choose Save invoice and read the result. Then open Saved, find the same invoice and check it again.
english: Choose Save invoice and read the result. Then open Saved, find the same invoice and check it again.
draft: Kies Stoor faktuur en lees die resultaat. Maak dan Gestoor oop, vind dieselfde faktuur en kontroleer dit weer.

key: Paid invoice kilogram lines can appear in My Records. Other units keep their original quantities; the app does not guess their weight. Check for the linked record before entering another sale.
english: Paid invoice kilogram lines can appear in My Records. Other units keep their original quantities; the app does not guess their weight. Check for the linked record before entering another sale.
draft: Kilogramreëls van betaalde fakture kan in My rekords verskyn. Ander eenhede behou hul oorspronklike hoeveelhede; die app raai nie hul gewig nie. Kontroleer vir die gekoppelde rekord voordat jy nog 'n verkoping invoer.

key: You can reopen the invoice and identify any save or synchronisation message that still needs attention.
english: You can reopen the invoice and identify any save or synchronisation message that still needs attention.
draft: Jy kan die faktuur weer oopmaak en enige stoor- of sinkroniseerboodskap identifiseer wat nog aandag nodig het.

key: Saved invoice → Share PDF or Print
english: Saved invoice → Share PDF or Print
draft: Gestoorde faktuur → Deel PDF of Druk

key: On the saved invoice, choose Share PDF or Print. Check the buyer, reference, dates, line items, total, payment status and payment details in the output.
english: On the saved invoice, choose Share PDF or Print. Check the buyer, reference, dates, line items, total, payment status and payment details in the output.
draft: Kies op die gestoorde faktuur Deel PDF of Druk. Kontroleer die koper, verwysing, datums, reëlitems, totaal, betaalstatus en betaalbesonderhede in die uitset.

key: Downloading a PDF does not mean the buyer received it. Choose the intended recipient yourself when you are ready to send a real invoice.
english: Downloading a PDF does not mean the buyer received it. Choose the intended recipient yourself when you are ready to send a real invoice.
draft: Om 'n PDF af te laai, beteken nie dat die koper dit ontvang het nie. Kies self die bedoelde ontvanger wanneer jy gereed is om 'n werklike faktuur te stuur.

key: When an unpaid invoice is later paid in full, reopen that same invoice or use Review payment. Check the actual receipt date and save the update.
english: When an unpaid invoice is later paid in full, reopen that same invoice or use Review payment. Check the actual receipt date and save the update.
draft: Wanneer 'n onbetaalde faktuur later ten volle betaal word, maak daardie selfde faktuur weer oop of gebruik Hersien betaling. Kontroleer die werklike ontvangsdatum en stoor die bywerking.

key: You have the right document for the right buyer, and have not recorded the sale twice.
english: You have the right document for the right buyer, and have not recorded the sale twice.
draft: Jy het die regte dokument vir die regte koper, en het nie die verkoping twee keer aangeteken nie.

english: You already saved the invoice yesterday. What should you do?
draft: Jy het die faktuur gister al gestoor. Wat moet jy doen?

english: Create a new sale and invoice
draft: Skep 'n nuwe verkoping en faktuur

key: Open the invoice from Saved
english: Open the invoice from Saved
draft: Maak die faktuur vanuit Gestoor oop

key: Yes. Reopen the same invoice, check it and use Share PDF or Print. Another copy is not another sale.
english: Yes. Reopen the same invoice, check it and use Share PDF or Print. Another copy is not another sale.
draft: Ja. Maak dieselfde faktuur weer oop, kontroleer dit en gebruik Deel PDF of Druk. Nog 'n afskrif is nie nog 'n verkoping nie.

key: Mark an unpaid invoice as paid
english: Mark an unpaid invoice as paid
draft: Merk 'n onbetaalde faktuur as betaal

key: A request for a copy is not evidence of payment. Check the payment separately and keep its status accurate.
english: A request for a copy is not evidence of payment. Check the payment separately and keep its status accurate.
draft: 'n Versoek vir 'n afskrif is nie bewys van betaling nie. Kontroleer die betaling afsonderlik en hou sy status akkuraat.

key: The VAT/tax-number field prints a reference; it does not calculate VAT or establish that the document meets tax-invoice requirements. Check current SARS guidance with your bookkeeper.
english: The VAT/tax-number field prints a reference; it does not calculate VAT or establish that the document meets tax-invoice requirements. Check current SARS guidance with your bookkeeper.
draft: Die BTW-/belastingnommerveld druk 'n verwysing; dit bereken nie BTW nie en bewys nie dat die dokument aan die vereistes vir 'n belastingfaktuur voldoen nie. Kontroleer huidige SARS-riglyne saam met jou boekhouer.

key: Current SARS VAT guidance
english: Current SARS VAT guidance
draft: Huidige SARS-riglyne oor BTW

key: Open Invoice when you are ready to work in your current workspace. Check whether the sale or invoice already exists before adding anything.
english: Open Invoice when you are ready to work in your current workspace. Check whether the sale or invoice already exists before adding anything.
draft: Maak Faktuur oop wanneer jy gereed is om in jou huidige werkruimte te werk. Kontroleer of die verkoping of faktuur reeds bestaan voordat jy iets byvoeg.

key: Bring paper and past sales into the app
english: Bring paper and past sales into the app
draft: Bring papier en vorige verkope in die app in

key: Keep the old paper. Record the sale once.
english: Keep the old paper. Record the sale once.
draft: Hou die ou papier. Teken die verkoping een keer aan.

key: Bring an earlier sale into the app with its original evidence, date and reference.
english: Bring an earlier sale into the app with its original evidence, date and reference.
draft: Bring 'n vroeër verkoping in die app in met sy oorspronklike bewyse, datum en verwysing.

key: Have the paper and payment evidence ready
english: Have the paper and payment evidence ready
draft: Hou die papier en betaalbewyse gereed

key: For practice, use the sample tour → Record the work and the sale → Try it now. Use a clearly marked fictional example. Sample changes reset on a full reload.
english: For practice, use the sample tour → Record the work and the sale → Try it now. Use a clearly marked fictional example. Sample changes reset on a full reload.
draft: Om te oefen, gebruik die voorbeeldtoer → Teken die werk en die verkoping aan → Probeer dit nou. Gebruik 'n duidelik gemerkte fiktiewe voorbeeld. Voorbeeldveranderinge word by 'n volledige herlaai teruggestel.

key: Look for the sale before entering it
english: Look for the sale before entering it
draft: Soek na die verkoping voordat jy dit invoer

key: My Records → Sold → Invoice → Saved
english: My Records → Sold → Invoice → Saved
draft: My rekords → Verkoop → Faktuur → Gestoor

key: Check both Sold and Saved. Match the reference, buyer, date, goods and amount. A paper copy and an app entry can describe the same sale.
english: Check both Sold and Saved. Match the reference, buyer, date, goods and amount. A paper copy and an app entry can describe the same sale.
draft: Kontroleer sowel Verkoop as Gestoor. Pas die verwysing, koper, datum, goedere en bedrag. 'n Papierafskrif en 'n app-inskrywing kan dieselfde verkoping beskryf.

key: You know whether the sale and an invoice are already recorded.
english: You know whether the sale and an invoice are already recorded.
draft: Jy weet of die verkoping en 'n faktuur reeds aangeteken is.

key: Sold → Past sale / paper invoice → What are you recording?
english: Sold → Past sale / paper invoice → What are you recording?
draft: Verkoop → Vorige verkoping / papierfaktuur → Wat teken jy aan?

key: Choose An invoice already written on paper to copy an existing paper invoice. Choose Produce already sold when you are documenting an earlier sale without that paper invoice.
english: Choose An invoice already written on paper to copy an existing paper invoice. Choose Produce already sold when you are documenting an earlier sale without that paper invoice.
draft: Kies 'n Faktuur wat reeds op papier geskryf is om 'n bestaande papierfaktuur oor te skryf. Kies Produkte reeds verkoop wanneer jy 'n vroeër verkoping sonder daardie papierfaktuur dokumenteer.

key: Answer Is this sale already in My Records? Choose Yes — link the existing sale if it is recorded. Choose No — record it with this invoice only after checking that it is absent.
english: Answer Is this sale already in My Records? Choose Yes — link the existing sale if it is recorded. Choose No — record it with this invoice only after checking that it is absent.
draft: Antwoord Is hierdie verkoping reeds in My rekords? Kies Ja — koppel die bestaande verkoping as dit aangeteken is. Kies Nee — teken dit met hierdie faktuur aan slegs nadat jy nagegaan het dat dit afwesig is.

key: Choose the entry type and existing-sale answer before filling the rest. Changing these choices starts a fresh form, so check all the details again.
english: Choose the entry type and existing-sale answer before filling the rest. Changing these choices starts a fresh form, so check all the details again.
draft: Kies die inskrywingstipe en die antwoord oor 'n bestaande verkoping voordat jy die res invul. As jy hierdie keuses verander, begin 'n nuwe vorm, so kontroleer al die besonderhede weer.

key: Link only the exact recorded sale
english: Link only the exact recorded sale
draft: Koppel slegs die presiese aangetekende verkoping

key: Yes — link the existing sale → Recorded sale
english: Yes — link the existing sale → Recorded sale
draft: Ja — koppel die bestaande verkoping → Aangetekende verkoping

key: Select the exact available sale in kilograms. Read its crop, weight, amount, buyer and date. Its recorded crop, kilograms, total and payment date stay together.
english: Select the exact available sale in kilograms. Read its crop, weight, amount, buyer and date. Its recorded crop, kilograms, total and payment date stay together.
draft: Kies die presiese beskikbare verkoping in kilogram. Lees sy gewas, gewig, bedrag, koper en datum. Sy aangetekende gewas, kilogram, totaal en betaaldatum bly saam.

key: If the app says the invoice is on another device, reopen it there. A linked sale can synchronise without copying the full invoice document. Connect to the internet before linking a real existing sale.
english: If the app says the invoice is on another device, reopen it there. A linked sale can synchronise without copying the full invoice document. Connect to the internet before linking a real existing sale.
draft: As die app sê die faktuur is op 'n ander toestel, maak dit daar weer oop. 'n Gekoppelde verkoping kan sinkroniseer sonder om die volledige faktuurdokument te kopieer. Verbind aan die internet voordat jy 'n werklike bestaande verkoping koppel.

key: Original paper invoice reference → Invoice issue date → Line items
english: Original paper invoice reference → Invoice issue date → Line items
draft: Oorspronklike papierfaktuurverwysing → Faktuuruitreikdatum → Reëlitems

key: For a paper copy, enter the original paper number and date. The app gives its copy an app invoice number too. Keep both references; the buyer’s order reference is a separate field.
english: For a paper copy, enter the original paper number and date. The app gives its copy an app invoice number too. Keep both references; the buyer’s order reference is a separate field.
draft: Vir 'n papierafskrif, voer die oorspronklike papiernommer en datum in. Die app gee sy afskrif ook 'n app-faktuurnommer. Hou albei verwysings; die koper se bestelverwysing is 'n afsonderlike veld.

key: Check the date in the document preview before saving. Copy the goods, quantities, units and agreed prices. A suggested price is not the price on your paper.
english: Check the date in the document preview before saving. Copy the goods, quantities, units and agreed prices. A suggested price is not the price on your paper.
draft: Kontroleer die datum in die dokumentvoorskou voordat jy stoor. Skryf die goedere, hoeveelhede, eenhede en ooreengekome pryse oor. 'n Voorgestelde prys is nie die prys op jou papier nie.

key: Record what actually happened to payment
english: Record what actually happened to payment
draft: Teken aan wat werklik met betaling gebeur het

key: Choose Yes — paid in full only when full payment is supported by checked evidence. Use its actual receipt date and method. An old invoice date does not prove the buyer paid that day.
english: Choose Yes — paid in full only when full payment is supported by checked evidence. Use its actual receipt date and method. An old invoice date does not prove the buyer paid that day.
draft: Kies Ja — ten volle betaal slegs wanneer volle betaling deur nagegaande bewyse ondersteun word. Gebruik sy werklike ontvangsdatum en metode. 'n Ou faktuurdatum bewys nie dat die koper op daardie dag betaal het nie.

key: For a linked recorded sale, preserve its recorded paid status and payment date. If they disagree with your evidence, resolve the original record instead of making a duplicate.
english: For a linked recorded sale, preserve its recorded paid status and payment date. If they disagree with your evidence, resolve the original record instead of making a duplicate.
draft: Vir 'n gekoppelde aangetekende verkoping, bewaar sy aangetekende betaalstatus en betaaldatum. As dit nie met jou bewyse ooreenstem nie, los die oorspronklike rekord op in plaas daarvan om 'n duplikaat te maak.

key: The invoice date and payment date each describe their own event.
english: The invoice date and payment date each describe their own event.
draft: Die faktuurdatum en betaaldatum beskryf elk hul eie gebeurtenis.

key: Save once and read the result. Find the same invoice again and compare the paper reference, issue date, buyer, units, total and payment status.
english: Save once and read the result. Find the same invoice again and compare the paper reference, issue date, buyer, units, total and payment status.
draft: Stoor een keer en lees die resultaat. Vind dieselfde faktuur weer en vergelyk die papierverwysing, uitreikdatum, koper, eenhede, totaal en betaalstatus.

key: If the message says the crop sale book still needs updating, reconnect and save the same invoice again. Keep the paper even after the app copy is saved.
english: If the message says the crop sale book still needs updating, reconnect and save the same invoice again. Keep the paper even after the app copy is saved.
draft: As die boodskap sê die gewasverkopeboek moet nog bygewerk word, verbind weer en stoor dieselfde faktuur weer. Hou die papier selfs nadat die app-afskrif gestoor is.

key: You can connect one source sale to its app document without counting its income twice.
english: You can connect one source sale to its app document without counting its income twice.
draft: Jy kan een bronverkoping aan sy app-dokument koppel sonder om sy inkomste twee keer te tel.

key: The old sale is already recorded.
english: The old sale is already recorded.
draft: Die ou verkoping is reeds aangeteken.

key: Your paper describes a sale already in My Records. What should you do first?
english: Your paper describes a sale already in My Records. What should you do first?
draft: Jou papier beskryf 'n verkoping wat reeds in My rekords is. Wat moet jy eerste doen?

english: Enter a second sale with today’s date
draft: Voer 'n tweede verkoping met vandag se datum in

english: That can duplicate income and change the story of when it happened. Find the existing record first.

key: Reopen its invoice, or link the exact eligible sale
english: Reopen its invoice, or link the exact eligible sale
draft: Maak sy faktuur weer oop, of koppel die presiese geskikte verkoping

key: Yes. Match the source first. If an invoice exists, reopen it; otherwise use the supported existing-sale link.
english: Yes. Match the source first. If an invoice exists, reopen it; otherwise use the supported existing-sale link.
draft: Ja. Pas eers die bron. As 'n faktuur bestaan, maak dit weer oop; gebruik andersins die ondersteunde skakel na 'n bestaande verkoping.

key: Link another sale with a similar amount
english: Link another sale with a similar amount
draft: Koppel 'n ander verkoping met 'n soortgelyke bedrag

key: A similar amount does not establish the same sale. Keep the evidence and resolve the missing match.
english: A similar amount does not establish the same sale. Keep the evidence and resolve the missing match.
draft: 'n Soortgelyke bedrag bewys nie dieselfde verkoping nie. Hou die bewyse en los die ontbrekende passing op.

key: An app copy does not replace missing source evidence. It does not convert units, establish tax compliance or repair an incorrect old record by itself.
english: An app copy does not replace missing source evidence. It does not convert units, establish tax compliance or repair an incorrect old record by itself.
draft: 'n App-afskrif vervang nie ontbrekende bronbewyse nie. Dit skakel nie eenhede om, bewys nie belastingnakoming en herstel nie op sy eie 'n verkeerde ou rekord nie.

english: Independent practice: find one existing sample invoice and identify its issue date and payment status. Explain which entry route you would use for a paper copy and when you must stop to check a possible duplicate.
draft: Onafhanklike oefening: vind een bestaande voorbeeldfaktuur en identifiseer sy uitreikdatum en betaalstatus. Verduidelik watter inskrywingsroete jy vir 'n papierafskrif sou gebruik en wanneer jy moet stop om 'n moontlike duplikaat na te gaan.

key: Start by checking Sold
english: Start by checking Sold
draft: Begin deur Verkoop na te gaan

key: Look for the existing sale before opening a past-sale or paper-copy form. Use the sample workspace until you can explain your choice.
english: Look for the existing sale before opening a past-sale or paper-copy form. Use the sample workspace until you can explain your choice.
draft: Soek na die bestaande verkoping voordat jy 'n vorm vir 'n vorige verkoping of papierafskrif oopmaak. Gebruik die voorbeeldwerkruimte totdat jy jou keuse kan verduidelik.

english: Review payment and share the right invoice
draft: Hersien betaling en deel die regte faktuur

english: Check payment. Send the right copy.

english: Update the existing invoice from checked payment evidence and inspect the document before sharing.
draft: Werk die bestaande faktuur by uit nagegaande betaalbewyse en ondersoek die dokument voordat jy deel.

key: Bring the invoice reference and payment evidence
english: Bring the invoice reference and payment evidence
draft: Bring die faktuurverwysing en betaalbewyse

key: Have the buyer, invoice number and payment evidence ready. A buyer asking for a copy is not proof of payment.
english: Have the buyer, invoice number and payment evidence ready. A buyer asking for a copy is not proof of payment.
draft: Hou die koper, faktuurnommer en betaalbewyse gereed. 'n Koper wat vir 'n afskrif vra, is nie bewys van betaling nie.

key: Reopen the correct invoice
english: Reopen the correct invoice
draft: Maak die regte faktuur weer oop

key: Invoice → Saved → Invoice number or Review payment
english: Invoice → Saved → Invoice number or Review payment
draft: Faktuur → Gestoor → Faktuurnommer of Hersien betaling

key: Find the existing invoice by number, buyer, issue date and total. Choose its row or Review payment to open it.

draft: Die dokument en koper stem ooreen met die betaling wat jy ondersoek.

key: Check the whole payment
english: Check the whole payment
draft: Kontroleer die hele betaling

key: Compare the payment record with the invoice
english: Compare the payment record with the invoice
draft: Vergelyk die betaalrekord met die faktuur

english: Check that the money was actually received and belongs to this invoice. Compare the amount and reference with your checked payment record.
draft: Kontroleer dat die geld werklik ontvang is en aan hierdie faktuur behoort. Vergelyk die bedrag en verwysing met jou nagegaande betaalrekord.

key: A promise, payment request or screenshot that you have not verified is not enough to say paid in full. Resolve differences before changing the status.
english: A promise, payment request or screenshot that you have not verified is not enough to say paid in full. Resolve differences before changing the status.
draft: 'n Belofte, betaalversoek of skermskoot wat jy nie geverifieer het nie, is nie genoeg om ten volle betaal te sê nie. Los verskille op voordat jy die status verander.

key: You can explain why the evidence supports full payment, or what remains unresolved.
english: You can explain why the evidence supports full payment, or what remains unresolved.
draft: Jy kan verduidelik waarom die bewyse volle betaling ondersteun, of wat onopgelos bly.

key: Has the buyer paid? → Payment received on → Payment method → Save invoice
english: Has the buyer paid? → Payment received on → Payment method → Save invoice
draft: Het die koper betaal? → Betaling ontvang op → Betaalmetode → Stoor faktuur

key: Once full payment is checked, choose Yes — paid in full. Check Payment received on and choose the method when known. Keep the original issue date.
english: Once full payment is checked, choose Yes — paid in full. Check Payment received on and choose the method when known. Keep the original issue date.
draft: Sodra volle betaling nagegaan is, kies Ja — ten volle betaal. Kontroleer Betaling ontvang op en kies die metode wanneer dit bekend is. Hou die oorspronklike uitreikdatum.

key: Save and read the result. Reopen the same invoice from Saved. Check the paid status, receipt date and method. The invoice number should stay the same.
english: Save and read the result. Reopen the same invoice from Saved. Check the paid status, receipt date and method. The invoice number should stay the same.

english: A sale linked from an existing record keeps its recorded payment details together. If these need correction, resolve that original record rather than making a new invoice.

key: One invoice now carries the checked payment, with no extra sale added.
english: One invoice now carries the checked payment, with no extra sale added.
draft: Een faktuur dra nou die nagegaande betaling, sonder dat 'n ekstra verkoping bygevoeg is.

key: Check the money book once
english: Check the money book once
draft: Kontroleer die geldboek een keer

key: My Records → Sold → View the related invoice
english: My Records → Sold → View the related invoice
draft: My rekords → Verkoop → Bekyk die verwante faktuur

key: Kilogram lines can provide crop-sale evidence. Bunches and bags keep their own units; the app does not guess their kilograms. Read the units beside the amount.
english: Kilogram lines can provide crop-sale evidence. Bunches and bags keep their own units; the app does not guess their kilograms. Read the units beside the amount.
draft: Kilogramreëls kan gewasverkoopbewyse verskaf. Bossies en sakke behou hul eie eenhede; die app raai nie hul kilogram nie. Lees die eenhede langs die bedrag.

key: If the invoice is saved on this device but its crop sale book update is pending, reconnect and save that same invoice again. Keep the source evidence while resolving the message.
english: If the invoice is saved on this device but its crop sale book update is pending, reconnect and save that same invoice again. Keep the source evidence while resolving the message.
draft: As die faktuur op hierdie toestel gestoor is maar die bywerking van sy gewasverkopeboek hangend is, verbind weer en stoor daardie selfde faktuur weer. Hou die bronbewyse terwyl jy die boodskap oplos.

key: The money and units still describe the original sale, counted once.
english: The money and units still describe the original sale, counted once.
draft: Die geld en eenhede beskryf steeds die oorspronklike verkoping, een keer getel.

key: Review the on-screen document first: seller and buyer, both references where relevant, dates, goods, units, prices, total, payment status and banking details.
english: Review the on-screen document first: seller and buyer, both references where relevant, dates, goods, units, prices, total, payment status and banking details.
draft: Hersien eers die dokument op die skerm: verkoper en koper, albei verwysings waar tersaaklik, datums, goedere, eenhede, pryse, totaal, betaalstatus en bankbesonderhede.

key: Share PDF and Print save the current form before producing output. Check your edits first. A paid document shows Invoice total and its Paid stamp; an unpaid document shows Total due.
english: Share PDF and Print save the current form before producing output. Check your edits first. A paid document shows Invoice total and its Paid stamp; an unpaid document shows Total due.
draft: Deel PDF en Druk stoor die huidige vorm voordat uitset geskep word. Kontroleer eers jou wysigings. 'n Betaalde dokument wys Faktuurtotaal en sy Betaal-stempel; 'n onbetaalde dokument wys Totaal verskuldig.

key: Share PDF opens a device share sheet where supported, or downloads a PDF. Check the generated copy. If PDF creation reports an error, the invoice may already be saved; follow the message and try Print rather than creating a duplicate.
english: Share PDF opens a device share sheet where supported, or downloads a PDF. Check the generated copy. If PDF creation reports an error, the invoice may already be saved; follow the message and try Print rather than creating a duplicate.
draft: Deel PDF maak 'n toestel-deelblad oop waar dit ondersteun word, of laai 'n PDF af. Kontroleer die gegenereerde afskrif. As die skep van die PDF 'n fout aandui, is die faktuur dalk reeds gestoor; volg die boodskap en probeer Druk eerder as om 'n duplikaat te skep.

key: For a real invoice, check the recipient and attachment before sending through your chosen app. Downloading or printing does not mean the buyer received it.
english: For a real invoice, check the recipient and attachment before sending through your chosen app. Downloading or printing does not mean the buyer received it.

key: If the buyer needs another copy, reopen and share the same invoice. Keep a checked copy with the source records.
english: If the buyer needs another copy, reopen and share the same invoice. Keep a checked copy with the source records.
draft: As die koper nog 'n afskrif nodig het, maak dieselfde faktuur weer oop en deel dit. Hou 'n nagegaande afskrif by die bronrekords.

key: The complete invoice stays on its original device. Seeing the sale on another device does not prove the full document is there too.
english: The complete invoice stays on its original device. Seeing the sale on another device does not prove the full document is there too.
draft: Die volledige faktuur bly op sy oorspronklike toestel. Om die verkoping op 'n ander toestel te sien, bewys nie dat die volledige dokument ook daar is nie.

key: You can identify which copy was sent, to whom, and which invoice it belongs to.
english: You can identify which copy was sent, to whom, and which invoice it belongs to.
draft: Jy kan identifiseer watter afskrif gestuur is, aan wie, en aan watter faktuur dit behoort.
